text.opengl: Write the post-processing shader – vertex shader: chaos swirls the texture coordinates with time, confuse mirrors them, shake wobbles the position; fragment shader: chaos = edge detection, confuse = inverted colours, shake = blur, all over 9 samples at `offsets` – add `SetFloat` and load the shader as `"postprocessing"`.
text.vulkan: Write the post-processing shaders – vertex shader: chaos swirls the texture coordinates with time, confuse mirrors them, shake wobbles the position; fragment shader: chaos = edge detection, confuse = inverted colours, shake = blur, all over 9 samples at `offsets` – and their C++ structs; give `createPipeline` and `LoadShader` the render pass and the sample count, and load the shader as `"postprocessing"` for the window's render pass.
text.d3d12: Write the postprocessing shader in `post_processing.hlsl` – vertex shader: chaos swirls the texture coordinates with time, confuse mirrors them, shake wobbles the position; pixel shader: chaos = edge detection, confuse = inverted colours, shake = blur, all over 9 samples at `offsets` – and load it as `"postprocessing"`.

hint.opengl: learnopengl's post_processing.vs / .frag. `if (chaos || shake) for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++) sample[i] = vec3(texture(scene, TexCoords.st + offsets[i]));` then `color += vec4(sample[i] * edge_kernel[i], 0.0)` (or `blur_kernel`). `LoadShader("post_processing.vs", "post_processing.fs", nullptr, "postprocessing");`
hint.vulkan: learnopengl's post_processing.vs / .frag with `pc.` and `kernels.` (and the two sign changes for Vulkan's y, see above). `if (pc.chaos != 0 || pc.shake != 0) for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++) samples[i] = vec3(texture(scene, TexCoords.st + kernels.offsets[i].xy));`. `LoadShader("shaders/post_processing.vert.spv", "shaders/post_processing.frag.spv", "postprocessing", VK_BLEND_FACTOR_ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA, renderPass, VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT);`
hint.d3d12: learnopengl's post_processing.vs / .frag in HLSL: `if (chaos || shake) for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++) samples[i] = scene.Sample(wrapSampler, input.texCoord + offsets[i]).rgb;` then `color += float4(samples[i] * edge_kernel[i], 0.0f)` (or `blur_kernel`). Chaos: `float2(texCoord.x + sin(time) * strength, texCoord.y - cos(time) * strength)` (v points down). `LoadShader(L"post_processing.hlsl", "postprocessing");`

text.opengl: Add learnopengl's PostProcessor as a struct, with `InitRenderData` (the screen quad) and `InitPostProcessor` (a multisampled framebuffer with a 4-sample renderbuffer, a second framebuffer with a texture, the quad and the shader's kernels); make the global `Effects` in Init; delete its objects at the end.
text.vulkan: Add learnopengl's PostProcessor as a struct, with `InitRenderData` (the screen quad), `createPostProcessingRenderPass` (a 4-sample colour attachment resolved into the texture) and `InitPostProcessor` (the two images, the render pass, the framebuffer, the quad, the kernels' uniform buffer and the descriptor set); set up the global `Effects` in Init; destroy its objects in `cleanup()`.
text.d3d12: Add learnopengl's PostProcessor as a struct, with `InitRenderData` (the screen quad) and `InitPostProcessor` (a 4× multisampled render target with its RTV, a texture to resolve it into with its SRV, the quad); make the global `Effects` in Init; release it in OnDestroy.

hint.opengl: `glRenderbufferStorageMultisample(GL_RENDERBUFFER, 4, GL_RGB, width, height);` and `glFramebufferRenderbuffer(GL_FRAMEBUFFER, GL_COLOR_ATTACHMENT0, GL_RENDERBUFFER, effects.RBO);`; for FBO: `glGenTextures(1, &effects.Texture.ID); Generate(effects.Texture, width, height, NULL);` and `glFramebufferTexture2D(…)`. `glUniform2fv(glGetUniformLocation(…, "offsets"), 9, (float*)offsets);`

text.opengl: Write `BeginRender` (draw into the multisampled framebuffer, cleared black), `EndRender` (resolve it into the texture framebuffer with a blit) and `Render` (the quad with the post shader and its options); in the game's `Render` wrap the drawing in BeginRender / EndRender and then draw the quad with the time.
text.vulkan: Write `BeginRender` (begin the off-screen pass, cleared black), `EndRender` (end it – the resolve – and begin the window's render pass) and `Render` (the quad with the post pipeline and its options as push constants); in the game's `Render` wrap the drawing in BeginRender / EndRender and then draw the quad with the time; make the sprite and particle pipelines for the off-screen pass with 4 samples, and let `recordCommandBuffer` leave the window's pass to EndRender.
text.d3d12: Write `BeginRender` (draw into the multisampled target, cleared black), `EndRender` (resolve it into the texture, then draw into the back buffer again) and `Render` (the quad with the post shader and its options); the PSOs of what is drawn into the multisampled target need 4 samples; in the game's `Render` wrap the drawing in BeginRender / EndRender and then draw the quad with the time.

hint.opengl: `glBindFramebuffer(GL_READ_FRAMEBUFFER, effects.MSFBO); glBindFramebuffer(GL_DRAW_FRAMEBUFFER, effects.FBO); glBlitFramebuffer(0, 0, effects.Width, effects.Height, 0, 0, effects.Width, effects.Height, GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT, GL_NEAREST);` then `glBindFramebuffer(GL_FRAMEBUFFER, 0);`. In Render(Game&): `BeginRender(Effects);` … `EndRender(Effects); Render(Effects, glfwGetTime());`.
hint.vulkan: BeginRender / EndRender: `VkRenderPassBeginInfo` with `effects.RenderPass, effects.Framebuffer` / `effects.WindowRenderPass, effects.WindowFramebuffer` and `vkCmdBeginRenderPass`; EndRender first `vkCmdEndRenderPass(effects.commandBuffer);`. In Render(Game&): `BeginRender(Effects);` … `EndRender(Effects); Render(Effects, static_cast<float>(glfwGetTime()));`. `LoadShader(…, Effects.RenderPass, VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_4_BIT);` for sprite and particle.
hint.d3d12: `Graphics.CommandList->ResolveSubresource(effects.Texture.Resource.Get(), 0, effects.MSRenderTarget.Get(), 0, effects.Texture.Internal_Format);` between the barriers (RENDER_TARGET ↔ RESOLVE_SOURCE, PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE ↔ RESOLVE_DEST), then `OMSetRenderTargets(1, &Graphics.BackBufferRtv, FALSE, nullptr);`. `Compile(…, UINT sampleCount = 1)` → `psoDesc.SampleDesc.Count = sampleCount;`. In Render(Game&): `BeginRender(Effects);` … `EndRender(Effects); Render(Effects, GetTime());`.

confuse.text: Try the first effect: switch `Confuse` on in Init, after the postprocessor is set up.

chaos.text: Replace the confuse line with the chaos effect.
chaos.hint: `Effects.Chaos = true;` (chaos wins over confuse in the shader anyway, but try one at a time).

shake.text: Remove the try-out line again; instead shake the screen when the ball hits a solid block: set `ShakeTime` to 0.05 seconds and `Effects.Shake`, and in `Update` count ShakeTime down and stop the shake when it is over.
shake.hint: In DoCollisions: `if (!box.IsSolid) box.Destroyed = true; else { ShakeTime = 0.05f; Effects.Shake = true; }`. In Update after the particles: `if (ShakeTime > 0.0f) { ShakeTime -= dt; if (ShakeTime <= 0.0f) Effects.Shake = false; }`. `float ShakeTime = 0.0f;` with the globals.
